script_nghe: Tell me about your family. … Well, I have one brother and three sisters. My brother’s name is Daniel. He’s a teacher at a primary school. My oldest sister lives in Australia now — she moved there two years ago.

writing.de_tom_tat: Viết 50–60 từ về gia đình: số người, tên và nghề của 2 người, một câu dùng sở hữu ’s.
writing.bai_mau: There are four people in my family: my parents, my sister and me. My father is a driver. He works for a transport company. My mother is a nurse. She works at a hospital near our house. My sister's husband is an engineer. They have one son.

cham_diem.vi_sao: Số người (four) · nghề của bố (driver) và mẹ (nurse) · thêm anh rể cho phong phú.
He works (bố) · She works (mẹ) — đúng giới. Người Việt hay lẫn vì tiếng Việt không phân biệt.
my sister's husband — dấu ' đặt trước s vì “sister” số ít.

dang_hoc: There are four people — không nói “My family has four people”, nghe rất Việt.
Sở hữu ’s chỉ dùng cho người: my sister's husband. Với đồ vật thì dùng of: the name of the book.
Nghề nghiệp luôn có a/an: a driver, a nurse, an engineer.
loi_thuong_gap: ❌ My family have 4 people. → ✅ There are four people in my family.
❌ my sister husband → ✅ my sister's husband
❌ My mother is nurse. → ✅ My mother is a nurse.

speaking.de_tom_tat: How many people are there in your family? / Tell me about your father or mother. / Who do you look like in your family?

cau_tra_loi.hoi: How many people are there in your family?
cau_tra_loi.mau: There are four of us: my parents, my sister and me. We're quite a small family.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: “four of us” tự nhiên hơn “four people”. Thêm nhận xét ngắn ở cuối để không cụt.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Tell me about your father or mother.
cau_tra_loi.mau: I'll talk about my mother. She's a nurse and she works at a hospital near our house. She's very patient, and she cooks really well.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Câu “I'll talk about…” cho bạn 2 giây nghĩ mà vẫn đang nói — không bị tính là im lặng.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Who do you look like in your family?
cau_tra_loi.mau: I look like my father. We have the same eyes and the same smile. But my personality is more like my mother's.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: “look like” là ngoại hình, “be like” là tính cách — hai cái khác nhau, đừng lẫn.

cham_diem.vi_sao: Câu nào cũng trả lời thẳng rồi mới mở rộng.
Dùng “I'll talk about…” để lấp chỗ nghĩ.
Chú ý /ð/ trong there, mother, father — đặt lưỡi giữa hai hàm răng, đừng đọc thành “d”.

meo_noi: mother /ˈmʌðə/ và father /ˈfɑːðə/ — âm /ð/ rung, khác hẳn “mother” đọc kiểu “mó-đờ”.
Số nhiều parents phải bật /s/ cuối: /ˈpeərənts/, không nuốt.
